findings.issue: Team cookie protocol (read/write, cookie name, TEAM_SIZE) duplicated across two client scripts and lib/team.ts, with magic strings that can drift from the server constants
findings.suggestion: Extract one shared client module (e.g. src/scripts/team-cookie.ts) imported by both scripts, or set the cookie via a small server endpoint

findings.issue: Dynamic filtering fetches the full page HTML and carves out #results with DOMParser; same pattern in team.astro and MovesSection.astro
findings.suggestion: Use Astro page partials (export const partial = true, e.g. /partials/results) as the current docs recommend for swapping HTML fragments client-side

findings.issue: load() never checks res.ok; on a 5xx the URL updates but results silently stay stale
findings.suggestion: Check res.ok (and the presence of the fragment) and fall back to location.assign as the catch already does

findings.issue: Requested page is clamped to totalPages but the URL keeps the out-of-range page param, desyncing URL and content
findings.suggestion: Replace the history entry with the clamped URL (or serve the 404/last page and normalize the query)

findings.issue: API payloads typed as `any` throughout despite astro/tsconfigs/strict, weakening the compiler's help at call sites (e.g. `v: any` in team.ts, `a: any` in pokemon page)
findings.suggestion: Add a small types module for the handful of API shapes actually consumed (Named, TypeInfo record, species, pokemon, move)
Move the `show`/missing-value formatter into lib/pokedex.ts next to DASH

findings.issue: API-provided type name interpolated into an inline CSS custom property without validation
findings.suggestion: Assert the slug shape (or CSS.escape the identifier) before interpolating

findings.issue: popstate triggers a full location.reload while the home page handles popstate with a fetch-swap; navigation semantics are inconsistent between pages
findings.suggestion: Unify history handling, ideally via one shared client navigation helper

findings.issue: No 500.astro, so upstream API failures surface as the default error page rather than an in-app one
findings.suggestion: Add a small 500.astro (Astro supports it for on-demand pages) that mirrors the Base layout

summary: A clean, current-Astro (7.4) server-rendered app: documented 404/cookie/SSR patterns, sensible lib layering, and careful progressive enhancement with correct race handling. The notable nits are the triplicated team-cookie protocol, full-page-fetch-and-carve where page partials are the documented primitive, and `any`-typed API payloads. I'd merge after one round of small changes.
